Usage: mekugi [flags] [Codex arguments...]
       mekugi [flags] codex [Codex arguments...]
       mekugi [flags] grok [Codex arguments...]
       mekugi [flags] codex headless --yolo [-m MODEL] [-c KEY=VALUE] < prompt.txt
       mekugi claude [--cwd DIR] [--resume SESSION] [--model MODEL]
       mekugi inspect-session --session PATH [options]
       mekugi inspect-storage --workspace DIR --call-id ID [options]
  -ansi-faint string
    	dim text: auto (detect mosh), on (ANSI faint), or off (fixed colors) (default "auto")
  -capture-output string
    	optional sanitized capture JSONL path
  -debug
    	record diagnostics, capture, metrics, instructions, runtime reads, and AX report; print session diagnosis command on exit
  -grok-auth-file string
    	Grok OAuth credential file (default ~/.grok/auth.json)
  -journal-compaction string
    	journal compaction: auto, slice, or off (default remains gated on evaluation) (default "off")
  -mode string
    	response mode: mekugi or passthrough (default "mekugi")
  -post-compact-recovery
    	restore journal and change context after compaction through a pre-trusted Codex hook (default true)
  -stream-idle-timeout duration
    	maximum upstream inactivity between WebSocket messages or HTTP response bytes (default 4m0s)
  -timeout duration
    	upstream response-start timeout (default 10m0s)
